summary: Iter-174 backend regression of shipment-editor PIN flow + container/pallet/item full-edit + child-file-doc 14-item checklist (synthetic flags). 12/12 pytest passed end-to-end against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend smoke verified /shipments admin detail view: all 4 new data-testids (ship-edit-container, ship-edit-pin, ship-add-pallet, ship-add-item) render, header shows new 'Container' + 'Set PIN' buttons, no runtime errors or console errors on page. Public donor-page PIN UI flow was NOT exercised in browser (relied on direct API regression covering pin_required, login 401 wrong PIN, edit-token roundtrip, anonymous 401, container/items/pallets via X-Shipment-Edit-Token).
action_items: Manually verify the public donor-page PIN flow in an anonymous (incognito) browser context: /donate/shipment/{token} → ship-donor-login button → enter '4321pin' → ship-donor-editor-badge appears → ship-donor-add-item dialog → add item → ship-donor-logout. Backend roundtrip for this exact path is already proven via pytest (test_public_edit_with_pin_token_works) so the remaining risk is purely client-state (localStorage persistence + UI re-render on logout).

Manually verify the 2D-visualizer pallet drag-to-place — backend persistence of pallets.$.x_cm/y_cm via PUT /shipments/{id}/pallets/{id} is verified passing (test_add_update_delete_pallet); the FloorPlan2D pointer-drag → API-call wiring lives in /app/frontend/src/components/ContainerVisualizer.jsx onPalletMove and should be smoke-tested in browser.

Manually verify ChildDocumentsPanel renders 14 doctype-row-* rows with synthetic 'auto' badge on child_photo + welfare_review. Backend correctly returns synthetic:true for those two and synthetic:undefined/false for the other 12 (test_synthetic_flag_set_on_child_photo_and_welfare passing).
critical_code_review_comments: Excellent security boundary in /app/backend/routers/shipments.py: require_shipment_editor cleanly accepts EITHER admin JWT OR HMAC-signed edit-token, with a 12h TTL on the edit-token. The HMAC uses JWT_SECRET as the key + a versioned salt 'shipment-edit-v1' — clean rotation path. Verified non-admin staff JWT → set-pin returns 403, anon POST /public/items returns 401, wrong PIN returns 401.

Public payload (GET /api/public/shipments/{token}) correctly exposes the new pin_required flag, container_dims_cm, pallet roster with full dims+positions, plus a sanitised donor leaderboard (top-5 by donated qty, anonymous excluded). donor_count uses a Set so duplicate donor names are correctly counted once. Total numeric fields are correctly rounded.

CHILD_FILE_DOC_TYPES is exactly the 14 entries from the customer's reference doc, ordered identically. Synthetic derivation is clean: child_photo from child.photo_url|profile_photo_url; welfare_review from db.social_review_forms.count_documents({child_id}). Non-synthetic counts come from db.child_extras with kind=file_doc + doc_type matching. test_doc_upload_increments_count proves the counter wires up correctly end-to-end through the upload-doc endpoint.

Minor: in /shipments PUT update endpoint, when container_dims_cm is provided we clamp each dim to >=50 cm — but max_payload_kg is not clamped (any positive float allowed). Consider a sanity ceiling (e.g. 50000 kg) so a typo can't break the UI's 'cap %' arithmetic. Not blocking.
Minor: public_delete_pallet correctly un-assigns items pointing at it (mirrors admin delete_pallet) — good consistency.

success_rate.frontend: Smoke only — admin /shipments detail view loads cleanly with all 4 new data-testids present (ship-edit-container, ship-edit-pin, ship-add-pallet, ship-add-item) and no console errors. Did NOT exercise dialog open/save flows in UI.

test_credentials: admin@5812uganda.org / Admin@5812 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Login at POST /api/auth/login with {identifier, password}, token in response.token.
seed_data_creation: Each test class creates and tears down its own scoped fixtures: shipment 'TEST_iter174_ship_*' (admin headers fixture), pallet 'TEST_Pallet_A' + 'TEST_pallet_for_item', item 'TEST_Soccer_Ball' + 'TEST_Public_Item', child 'TEST_iter174_child_*' (created via /api/children if no existing children present), staff user 'TEST_iter174_staff_*@example.com' via /api/admin/users. All deleted on fixture teardown. PIN '4321pin' set on the test shipment then removed when the shipment is deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints in the PIN/container/pallet/item-edit + child-file-docs feature drop are verified via /app/backend/tests/test_iter174_shipments_pin.py — re-run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iter174_shipments_pin.py -v`. The 5 frontend flows (donor-page PIN login UI, 2D-viz pallet drag, ChildDocumentsPanel synthetic badge, upload-doc check-mark, edit-item full dialog) were NOT exercised via Playwright due to token budget — code-review confirms wiring is correct (all data-testids requested by reviewer are present), and the backend they call is green. If retesting in browser: use a SEPARATE Playwright context (browser.new_context()) for the anonymous donor-page flow to avoid admin cookies bleeding in.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All requested backend endpoints behave per spec: (a) anon POST /api/public/shipments/{token}/items → 401, (b) POST /api/public/shipments/{token}/login wrong PIN → 401, (c) non-admin POST /api/shipments/{id}/set-pin → 403, (d) admin set-pin → public_shipment.pin_required becomes true, (e) admin set-pin → public login returns edit_token usable for items/pallets/container endpoints, (f) child file-doc-types returns exactly 14 entries with synthetic:true on child_photo + welfare_review and per-type counts (derived for synthetic, db-counted for real), (g) container_dims_cm + max_payload_kg persist correctly through admin PUT, (h) pallet create/update/delete with x_cm/y_cm/color/dims works, (i) item full edit including dims_cm, pallet_id, x_cm/y_cm/z_cm, priority all persist.
